label: ChEMBL ligands
caption: 8,981 ligands active against one of six protein targets (pChEMBL of at least 6), from ChEMBL, a quarter of each target's ligands in each period. Each ligand is linked to its ten most similar earlier ligands by the Tanimoto similarity of ECFP4 fingerprints, and the ligands up to 2008 by their minimum spanning tree. FlingVis was fitted to the 2,550 ligands published up to 2008.
